title: Does double descent appear where theory says? Reproducing the interpolation-threshold peak across model families

original_idea.body:
# Reproducing the Interpolation-Threshold Peak

Sweep capacity for MLP and kernel models with/without label noise; locate peak vs theoretical threshold.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Vague impact: double descent ties to inductive bias broadly with no specific catastrophic scenario.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Capacity sweep on MLP/kernel with synthetic data; classic beginner exercise.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped reproduction-and-perturbation with clear peak-location metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Mixed: fully external and reproducible but double descent is a textbook-level studied phenomenon with limited new value.

novelty.reasoning: Double descent and its threshold dependence are extensively reproduced.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Double descent peak/threshold behavior is heavily studied and reproduced.
